items.title: Minor "Ram" Hall Interview, 1958-09-02
items.q: His right name was Joseph Hall. Yeah, and he was a drummer.

ctx.x: Well, well, Monroe came from the other side over there, St. James Parish.

Yeah, that's right. I think Papa Mutt, too, came from Hornsville. Yeah, I grew up in Hornsville. Yeah, so after all my mother and father, they moved from Yolens, I think I was about two years old, and I was practically raised in Yolens, and my brother, I don't know how he got started. See, my father was a drummer. Oh, was that like a drummer? Yeah, my old man, he used to play in brass band and things up in the country. What was his name? His right name was Joseph Hall. Yeah, and he was a drummer.
Did he play up in the country or down in New York?
